scope: T10 preference proposals, explicit version selection, evidence-backed exploration and bounded source fallback; not a completed eval run
hard_gates: Only the current sealed reviewed catalog can supply candidates, facts or budget qualification
Preference proposals remain inferred and cannot enable a hard constraint without explicit user confirmation
A proposed mapping cites a span present in the user's input and a reviewed catalog tag; it is not proof of whisky preference
Expert entry has an exact user-confirmed release/item reference before recommending from a starting bottle
At most three candidates; no fill, automatic relaxation, missing-tag negatives or fabricated intensities
Clicks and confirmed language proposals apply the same condition command; unmentioned fields remain unchanged
Source failures are retained; fallback is limited to provided reviewed source references and cannot publish its observations
Revision, owner, receipt replay and historical-result fences remain enforced

human_rubric.scale: 1–5 per category with per-case reasons; not yet reviewed
human_rubric.traditional_chinese: Readable Traditional Chinese distinguishes cited facts, editorial tags, inferred clues and unknowns
human_rubric.preference_confirmation: A beginner can confirm or reject individual clues; temporary budget is not a permanent preference
human_rubric.version_question: Version choices are specific, complete for the matched reviewed name, and precede starting-bottle comparison
human_rubric.comparison_evidence: Each retained or explored feature links to positive reviewed evidence; no inferred intensity or claimed absence
human_rubric.source_recovery: A failed source is auditable and a bounded valid alternative is selected, or the limitation remains explicit
